classification.classification_reason: The article focuses on the experiences of young people who are not in education, employment or training (Neets) in the UK, particularly those from Wirral, Merseyside.

content.title: Michael's Journey: From Anxiety to Job
content.caption: A young man's story of falling out of education, employment, and training due to mental health issues and how he found support and eventually landed a job.

slides.heading: Michael's Journey: From Anxiety to Job
slides.text: A young man's story of falling out of education, employment, and training due to mental health issues and how he found support and eventually landed a job.

slides.heading: The Problem
slides.text: A significant rise in anxiety and mental health problems among young people, with one in five Neets having a mental health condition compared to one in five in 2012.

slides.heading: Support and Progress
slides.text: Michael received support from mentors and the Merseyside Youth Association, which helped him improve his mental health and find a job.
